scope: Candidate holdouts on the existing four physical decks, not unseen decks. Historical cards bypass age only for this diagnostic.

alela-artifacts.name: Losheel, Clockwork Scholar
alela-artifacts.check: Artifact-creature entries draw at most once each turn. Alela's Faeries are not artifact creatures. Combat damage prevention applies to attacking artifact creatures, not all attackers.

alela-artifacts.name: Mystic Forge
alela-artifacts.check: Top-of-library permission covers artifact spells and colorless spells, not every spell and not playing lands. Colored nonartifact spells can obstruct it; exile activation costs tap and one life.

alela-artifacts.name: Shimmer Myr
alela-artifacts.check: Flash permission is for artifacts, not all permanents. Casting artifact spells on opponents' turns can trigger Alela; merely putting an artifact onto the battlefield does not.

alela-artifacts.name: Herald's Horn
alela-artifacts.check: Choose a creature type, not Artifact. Faerie tokens are not creature spells cast and are not library cards. Upkeep selection is conditional, not unconditional draw.

alela-artifacts.name: Whirlwind of Thought
alela-artifacts.check: Red color identity makes this ineligible for Alela regardless of the appealing noncreature-cast effect.

alela-artifacts.name: Wizard's Staff
alela-artifacts.check: Ordinary Equip {3} can equip Alela. Trigger doubling does not double activated abilities. Do not invent a Wizard restriction or miscount supplied Wizards.

alela-artifacts.name: Fateful Discovery
alela-artifacts.check: Artifact entries trigger Discovery, not Alela. Discovery itself is an enchantment and casting it does trigger Alela.

alela-artifacts.name: Surgical Precision
alela-artifacts.check: Sorcery: destroy a creature with toughness 4 or greater and gain 1 life, or draw a card and gain 2 life. Do not substitute Prophesied End's text.

alela-enchantments.name: Moon-Blessed Cleric
alela-enchantments.check: ETB tutors an enchantment to the top of the library, not hand or battlefield. The Cleric is not itself an enchantment.

alela-enchantments.name: Ondu Spiritdancer
alela-enchantments.check: Copy an entering enchantment at most once each turn. Token copies enter but are not cast, so do not directly retrigger Alela or enchantment-cast payoffs.

alela-enchantments.name: Starfield Mystic
alela-enchantments.check: Discount is generic mana for enchantment spells. Counters result from controlled enchantments going from battlefield to graveyard, not casting or entering.

alela-enchantments.name: Tocasia's Welcome
alela-enchantments.check: Entry threshold is mana value 3 or less, not power or toughness. Ordinary Alela tokens have mana value zero. Draw triggers only once each turn, not per token.

alela-enchantments.name: Eidolon of Rhetoric
alela-enchantments.check: One spell per turn applies to each player including its controller; this can hinder chaining enchantments even if pillowfort benefits. Not one spell per round or opponents-only.

alela-enchantments.name: Wizard's Staff
alela-enchantments.check: Alela can be equipped for {3} and her cast trigger doubled. A rejection needs an actual opportunity-cost argument, not an assumption that she cannot be equipped.

alela-enchantments.name: Fateful Discovery
alela-enchantments.check: Casting Discovery itself triggers Alela because it is an enchantment. Its subsequent draw condition is artifact entry, not enchantment casts or Faerie entries.

alela-enchantments.name: Prophesied End
alela-enchantments.check: Instant, not sorcery. Destroy a target creature; its controller draws if it was not attacking. No lifegain and no toughness threshold.

camellia-food.name: Ruthless Technomancer
camellia-food.check: ETB optionally sacrifices another creature for Treasures equal to power, not toughness. Recursion sacrifices X artifacts, X nonzero, and returns a creature with power at most X. A Food creature qualifies for ETB; noncreature Food does not.

camellia-food.name: Ygra, Eater of All
camellia-food.check: Other creatures, including opponents', become Food artifacts; Ygra excludes itself. Ward cost belongs to targeting opponent. Food-to-graveyard triggers are not limited to own sacrifices. Respect no-infinite-combo goal; another candidate is not current support.

camellia-food.name: Trading Post
camellia-food.check: Every mode costs one mana and tap, plus its stated resource. Artifact sacrifice can consume noncreature Food and draw; creature sacrifice returns an artifact to hand, not battlefield. One sacrifice cannot pay two modes.

camellia-food.name: Night of Souls' Betrayal
camellia-food.check: Global -1/-1 hits own creatures too; ordinary 1/1 Squirrels die absent a buff. Do not describe it as opponents-only or an anthem for the deck.

camellia-food.name: Mirkwood Bats
camellia-food.check: Body is 2/3. Creating or sacrificing each token drains each opponent; do not invent a nontoken or once-per-turn restriction.

camellia-food.name: Ashnod's Altar
camellia-food.check: Sacrifices creatures, including Food creatures such as Tough Cookie and Gingerbrute, which can trigger Camellia. Does not sacrifice noncreature Foods. Other outlets do not share one payment.

camellia-food.name: Emrakul, the Exigent Doom
camellia-food.check: Ward sacrifice is paid by the targeting opponent, not the permanent's controller. Nonpayment counters the opposing spell/ability. Review hand ability as printed rather than inventing costs.

camellia-food.name: Ginger, Queen of Sweets
camellia-food.check: Its upkeep Gingerbrute tokens are Food artifact creatures. Monarch dependence and six mana are real costs, but denying Food support is not.

talrand-spells.name: Roaming Throne
talrand-spells.check: Choose Wizard or Merfolk to double Talrand's triggered ability. Does not double all spells, static abilities, or its own triggers. Its ward cost is paid by targeting opponent.

talrand-spells.name: Shark Typhoon
talrand-spells.check: Noncreature-spell casts make Sharks by mana value. Cycling draws and creates a Shark but is not casting an instant/sorcery and does not itself trigger Talrand.

talrand-spells.name: Deekah, Fractal Theorist
talrand-spells.check: Casting or copying an instant/sorcery triggers Deekah; ordinary copies are not cast and do not trigger Talrand. Token starts 0/0 with counters equal to mana value, not power.

talrand-spells.name: Jace's Sanctum
talrand-spells.check: Reduces generic cost of instants/sorceries and scries on their casts. Does not draw cards, discount colored symbols or require a Jace planeswalker.

talrand-spells.name: Talrand's Invocation
talrand-spells.check: Sorcery creates two 2/2 flying Drakes; casting it with Talrand present adds one more from the cast trigger. Token creation itself does not retrigger Talrand.

talrand-spells.name: Variable Chaser // Arc of Fortune
talrand-spells.check: Printed prepared reminder allows casting a copy and unprepares the creature. Do not deny that explicit access; do not invent free casting or fully specified novel-keyword timing.

talrand-spells.name: Keeper of the Quiet Hour
talrand-spells.check: Empower reminder creates a Jace token if absent and puts loyalty counters on it. Existing Jace support is not necessary for the printed self-contained effect.

talrand-spells.name: Metallurgic Summonings
talrand-spells.check: Instant/sorcery casts create Constructs by mana value. Five-mana opportunity cost is defensible; its graveyard-return activation needs six artifacts and exiles the enchantment.
